title: Voice Mode GA — Registry Upgrade Trigger Met (Early Preview → Implemented)
description: The re-evaluation trigger for Voice Mode (registered 2026-03-04 as EARLY_PREVIEW, ~5% rollout) has been met: official Anthropic docs at code.claude.com/docs/en/voice-dictation now document /voice with stable semantics. Features now documented: /voice command activates push-to-talk mode, configurable keybindings via ~/.claude/keybindings.json (rebind voice:pushToTalk), settings keys for voiceEnabled and language, 20-language STT support (added Russian, Polish, Turkish, Dutch, Ukrainian, Greek, Czech, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian in v2.1.69), and voice mode is fully available (not 5% rollout). This is a registry status upgrade, not a new discovery — the registry entry should be updated from EARLY_PREVIEW to IMPLEMENTED. Config: add keybinding for voice:pushToTalk if desired; activate with /voice.

evaluation.reasoning: This is a registry status upgrade, not a new integration. The trigger has been met: official Anthropic docs confirm Voice Mode is stable and fully available (no longer 5% rollout). Integration complexity (100): only action is updating the registry status from EARLY_PREVIEW to IMPLEMENTED and optionally adding a keybinding. Token efficiency (50): neutral — voice input doesn't affect token efficiency. Capability expansion (40): capability already registered; this updates its status to reflect production readiness. Maintenance burden (100): zero, it's a documentation update. Community validation (100): official Anthropic source. Integration action: update registry/existing-capabilities.md Voice Mode entry from EARLY_PREVIEW to IMPLEMENTED, note stable config options (voiceEnabled setting, voice:pushToTalk keybinding).
